# KSSL

The USDA-NRCS NCSS Kellogg Soil Survey Laboratory libraries of soils from the United States and other territories

## Overview

- **Sample size:** 90,000+
- **Version:** snapshot Jul 2022
- **Spectral range:** vnir, mir
- **Extent:** national

## Map

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/soilspectroscopy/ossl-imports/main/dataset/KSSL/README_files/figure-gfm/map-1.png)

## Database access

[Open dataset files](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/KSSL/)

## Soil laboratory information

- **n properties available:** 1000+
- **n properties standardized:** 51
- **n properties harmonized:** pending
- **properties themes:** physical, chemical, biological, hydrological, carbon & nutrients, metal elements

## Soil site information

- **coordinates precision:** precise, county, country
- **sampling depth:** various
- **geography:** soil taxonomy, soil horizon

## MIR

- **Acquisition mode:** Not available
- **Intensity:** reflectance
- **Original range:** 400-4000
- **Standardized range:** 600-4000
- **Instrument:** Vertex 70 FT-IR
- **Manufacturer:** Bruker Optics
- **Scan accessory:** Not available
- **Sample preparation:** Air-dried, finely ground < 80mesh
- **Additional info:** detector, beamsplitter, background, mirror material, sample dilution, sample presentation
